variants.briefing:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to [Destination]. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows
